title: Social Content Pack
subtitle: 35 ready-to-post captions for salons & beauty
statusNote: Ship-ready — 35 templates, 7 categories. Stage 4 review optional before listing.
coverStatement: 35 captions for salons & beauty. Ready to copy and post.

intro.hookDescription: This pack has 35 captions for the moments that actually come up — open chairs, a result you're proud of, a slow Tuesday, a question for the feed, a new follower who needs a reason to book. Most are ready to copy and post.
intro.howToUse: Pick the category that matches your week — that's the scenario. The caption is the post: lead with the result, vibe, or hook. Most lines are written ready to post. A few marked with (I/my/me) vs we/our/us are for solo stylists — swap only on those. Fill [brackets] if needed.
intro.fillInNote: Only swap (I/we) or (my/our) or (me/us) where the template shows it — everything else is already in salon or neutral voice. Other fill-ins: [your town], [your specialty or service], [day].
intro.identityKitNote: If you have an Identity Kit, swap in a line from your Voice and Content Playbook anywhere it fits. The pack works without it.

categories.title: If you're new here
categories.description: For when a new follower lands on your profile — referral energy, local pride, a reason to book.

templates.text: We've been called a hidden gem so many times we're starting to wonder if we need a bigger sign.
We're not trying to go viral, we just want to be the salon you keep coming back to.
If someone sent you here, they probably wouldn't shut up about their last visit.
First time in (my/our) chair? (I/We) still get stupid excited. DM (me/us).
In [your town], good hair travels by word of mouth. Consider this your invite.

categories.title: Open chair this week
categories.description: For a slow day, an open slot, or room on the books — pair with a chair shot or calendar post.

templates.text: Open chair today. If your hair's been telling you it needs attention, this is your sign!
It's a slow day at the salon, we take walk-ins.
Sit back and relax — if you need extra time in the chair, we've got you. No rush.
[day] just opened up. DM (me/us) or link in bio.
One more [your specialty or service] slot this week!!

categories.title: What you can expect
categories.description: For a process shot, tool flat-lay, or consultation clip — name the service, not the backstory.

templates.text: [your specialty or service] consults — link in bio. (We'll/I'll) figure out what your hair actually needs.
Less is more, babes. Sometimes a gloss + a trim is the whole move.
Big change? We talk it through first. No surprises.
We keep your formula on file. Every visit builds on the last.
Don't love it when you walk out? We fix it. Period.

categories.title: A client moment
categories.description: For a before/after or finished look — lead with the result; the photo does the rest.

templates.text: This is your sign you don't need a full transformation — sometimes it's enhancing what you already have.
Got those curls back.
[your specialty or service] — soft dimension, lived-in glow, depth where it matters.
Refresh, not reinvention.
Partial highlight up top with rich color underneath. Swipe to see the before.

categories.title: The regulars
categories.description: For salon vibe, team, or personality posts — not a loyalty speech.

templates.text: (I/We) get to make people feel beautiful for a living. Thanks for trusting (me/us) with your hair.
When she needs something and we're six clients deep.
Good hair is the standard. Feeling like yourself is the goal.
Having someone wash your hair is a top-tier luxury. That's it. That's the post.
Daily wash or 2–3x a week? Tell us in the comments.

categories.title: A win this week
categories.description: For a transformation or result you're proud of — seasonal punch, technique, or hot take.

templates.text: Sun is out, blonde is in!!! Who's ready for summer?!
[your specialty or service] — depth at the root, brightness where it matters. Link in bio.
When the lift is so good you don't even need to tone the ends.
Grey blending. What grey? She's a blonde bombshell.
Blonding rules I live by: low and slow. No heat while processing. Your tips? Drop them below.

categories.title: Start a conversation
categories.description: For when you want replies, not just likes — poll energy or a casual question, no fresh result required.

templates.text: Lived-in color or full refresh? Pick a side.
What's the best part of a salon visit for you? We'll go first: the shampoo.
What was one good thing you did for yourself this month?
Curly, straight, or somewhere in between. What does your hair look like on a good day?
Same hair, two different finishes. One of these walks out of the salon every week. Which would you pick?
